limits: Mutation regressions are detected by named directed tests; the normal-transition sampled invariants do not independently detect two of the explicit mutants.
The repeated-open test now checks exact retained selection, focus target, focus command count and mutation count; the focused-only mutant proves its count assertion is active.
This is reducer-level correspondence only and omits full binding, authority, stamps, outputs, current-read identity, menu/choice guards, native delivery, physical focus and assistive technology.
